name: deGoog
description: Self-hosted search aggregator you can extend with plugins.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything deGoog keeps: installed engines, plugins, themes, transports, settings files and the search index.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Web UI and search API, published on host as 6141.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: DEGOOG_SETTINGS_PASSWORDS
variables.description: Password for the Settings page. Leave it empty and deGoog makes a new one each time it starts and prints it in the app log. Type your own to keep the same one. Several passwords can be split with commas.
